optimized_sql:
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT ss_sold_time_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales
) AS ss
JOIN (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
) AS hd
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_store_name = 'ese'
) AS s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_hour = 8
      AND t_minute >= 30
) AS td
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
ORDER BY count(*)
LIMIT 100
